newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Infotech group Listco to seek JSE listing.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Infotech group Listco to seek JSE listing.

text.p: An information technology group, currently known as Listco, plans to seek a Johannesburg Stock Exchange listing in September through a clawback offer by Sub Nigel Gold Mining Co Ltd, it said in a statement on Tuesday.
The principal components of the group are software and consulting company Ironbridge, networking and micro-computer product firm Prologic Business Systems and employee provider Prologic Contracting.

"The concept of creating and listing Listco has been well conceptualised by all the parties and our ability to list as soon as September has been made possible by mobilising the Sub-Nigel shareholder base," Ironbridge chief executive officer Graham Vermaak said.
He said Sub-Nigel had announced a clawback offer, a feature of which was to offer shareholders a participation in Listco through a renounceable rights offer which would raise some 15 million rand.
Participation in the clawback offer would require registration as a shareholder of Sub-Nigel by August 1,
